answer.why_different: The generated document adds the entire path as a structural difference: the official side has no corresponding path, while the generated side defines the 3GPP resource URI and its operations. This is probably an omission or outdated structure on the official side, not a different path value.
answer.spec_3gpp: The 3GPP specification explicitly defines this resource URI as `{MnSRoot}/ProvMnS/{MnSVersion}/{URI-LDN-first-part}/{className}={id}`. It identifies PUT as creating a managed object instance and DELETE as deleting managed object instances on this URI.
answer.openapi: The OpenAPI reference permits a Paths Object entry whose field begins with `/`, and the Path Item Object supports PUT and DELETE operations. Therefore, the generated path is a valid and appropriate OpenAPI structure.
answer.clearer_why: Only the generated version exposes the managed-object-instance endpoint; the official side is absent, so it cannot communicate the resource or its available operations to an API reader.
